title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Holland International Blues Festival | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Holland International Blues Festival in Grolloo, Netherlands, on 8 June 2018.

It was the fourth show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Here’s the band’s version of The Beatles’ 1967 song ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’:

What a great night we had the blues festival in. Grolloo Holland peace and love and thanks for a great night Ringo and they all stars. ???????????? pic.twitter.com/kzcyblcmli

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) June 8, 2018

Yes it’s peace and love Tuesday peace and love ??????????? pic.twitter.com/e5RDA6K7CS

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) June 5, 2018
